brief: Two-storey Italianate brick town house of about 1854: a low hipped roof with bracketed eaves, tall arched windows with hood moulds, an iron-railed stoop, and a side bay; an iron fence along the sidewalk. Record: 1 photo plus 12 measured drawing sheets.

facade.notes: the Macy House (Indianapolis, 1854): a two-storey Italianate block with a deep bracketed cornice and small attic windows in the frieze, an iron balconette over the door, shutters, arched windows on the side wing; an iron fence behind a later rail fence along the street

why.note: 1850s Italianate: the city's new fashion for merchants
